note: Borrowed assets for the inhabited-room study: people, surrounding vegetation, ground textures and sky. None of it is Bower geometry or Bower planting. The files are not in git: `python fetch_assets.py` downloads them into ./assets and writes assets.lock.json (every file, its source address, size and hash).

hdris.use: sky, sunlight and the distant tree line

textures.use: the room floor and the approach path (a bound gravel surface)
the surface of the planting beds
the care path round the back of the beds

models.use: garden trees to the north and east, as a generic small deciduous tree
the mixed border and the garden side of the beds
the mixed border and the garden side of the beds
the shaded bed edges and the damp hollow
low cover on the beds across the four planted bays
the unmown strip beside the care path
the unmown strip beside the care path
a log left by the border

rocketbox.note: Rigged, clothed figures. Only the colour textures are fetched, and they are reduced from 2048 px TGA to texture_px JPEG or PNG to keep the study light.
